camel_example: aliyun ice CreateSearchIndex --region cn-hangzhou --IndexType mm --version 2020-11-09 --method POST --force
description_en: Creates a search index in a specified search library, supporting face, intelligent tag, and large model search indexes
description_zh: 在指定搜索库中创建搜索索引，支持人脸、智能标签和大模型搜索索引
name: CreateSearchIndex

parameters.help_en:
The name of the search library.

If you do not specify a search library name, the search index is created in the default search library of IMS by default. Default value: ims-default-search-lib.
You can also call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2584455.html operation to query existing search library information
parameters.help_zh:
搜索库名称。

未填写搜索库名称时，默认情况下搜索索引会被创建在IMS的默认搜索库下。默认值ims-default-search-lib。
您还可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2584455.html接口查询已有的搜索库信息
parameters.name: search_lib_name

parameters.help_en:
The index type. Valid values:
mm: large model visual state. Describes complex visual features and actions in videos, which helps identify and search for specific actions, movements, and events in videos, such as a football player scoring a goal or a basketball player getting injured.

The shared edition supports 1,000 hours of video. After the quota is exceeded, the system no longer performs large model visual state analysis.
face: automatic face recognition. Describes facial features in videos. By using face recognition technology, faces in videos can be automatically tagged and searched.

The shared edition supports 1 million face analyses. After the quota is exceeded, the system no longer performs face analysis.
aiLabel: intelligent tag. Describes subtitles, speech, and other content in videos. By using text and speech recognition technologies, language information such as subtitles and dialogues in videos can be automatically extracted for tagging and searching. This helps users quickly search for and locate content involving specific topics or keywords in videos
parameters.help_zh:
索引类别。取值：
mm：大模型视觉状态。用于描述视频中的复杂视觉特征和动作，可以帮助识别和搜索视频中特定的动作、运动以及事件。如足球运动员射球进门、篮球运动员受伤等情况。

共享型支持1000小时的视频，超出后，系统将不再进行大模型视觉状态分析。
face：人脸自动识别。用于描述视频中的人脸特征，通过人脸识别技术，可以对视频中的人脸进行自动标记和搜索。

共享型支持100万人脸分析，超出后，系统将不再进行人脸分析。
aiLabel：智能标签。智能标签索引类别用于描述视频中的字幕、语音等内容。通过文本和语音识别技术，可以自动提取视频中的字幕、对话等语言信息进行标记和搜索。帮助用户快速搜索和定位视频中涉及特定话题或关键字的内容
parameters.name: index_type

parameters.help_en:
The index status. Default value: Active. Valid values:
Active: activated.
Deactive: deactivated
parameters.help_zh:
索引状态。默认值Active。取值：
Active：激活。
Deactive：失效
parameters.name: index_status

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:
true: The call was successful.                  
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功，取值：
true：调用成功                  
false：调用失败
